Vemuram Myriad | AllThePedals Articles Genealogy Browse Search results for " " Gain / Fuzz / Vemuram Myriad Myriad The Vemuram Myriad is a unique fuzz pedal developed in collaboration with Josh Smith. It features a flexible design with both Germanium and Silicon transistors, offering a wide range of tones from spitty to smooth, and can be used with two amps for a variety of routing options. It's a versatile fuzz that allows for a "Myriad" of combinations, combining the fuzz, loop and mixer effects. It's a new generation concept with myriad of combinations. What Vemuram say about the Myriad The Myriad took more than 2 years to complete with Josh Smith's inspirational idea. This pedal is a mixture of the Myriad Fuzz, Loop, and a mixer that can do literally "Myriad" of combinations. The fuzz can be switched between 2 ouputs and lets you mix the loop and the fuzz if the signal is in the wet chain. (Please see the attached matrix table inside the control manual for more details). The Mix can be controlled by an expression pedal or the control knob on the center of the pedal(red knob). A unique fuzz that employ's both Germanium and Silicon transistors. It goes from fire breathing silicon to cool warm germanium easily, it cleans up just like the vintage fuzzes, and is more dynamic and organic. It goes from spitty to smooth driven sound. It also has a large amount of volume on tap and a tone circuit that allows it to really work live. The Myriad can plug into 2 amps to let you achieve countless options with other effects, a new generation concept with Myriad of combintations. Josh Smith's Comment "The Myriad is the end result of years of ideas and explortion. I wanted a way to be creative in a two amp situation, this pedal cracks the code on creativity by giving you literally "myriad" of routing options and possibilities. Plus, in my opinion the best fuzz pedal in the world." www.vemuram.com Myriad compared to ...
